answer: Assume every identity honest, then pay an ocean of bounty hunters to prove otherwise: challenge and attestation rewards vest across several epochs, and anyone may post a fraud claim with evidence — shared payout trails, lockstep timing, template prose. If graders confirm, the sybil's vested rewards go to the hunter. Plant an orchard of incentives and scale becomes the farm's liability: each new puppet is one more chance to be caught, so the attacker's expected return enters a death spiral as the farm grows.
